INPUT.DATASET_INVARIANT_BROKEN: The saved dataset failed its integrity check. Import a fresh copy.
UNIT.OFFSET_TRANSFORM_UNSAFE: Use Kelvin for absolute temperature, or a delta unit for a temperature difference, before this operation.
TRANSFORM.DOMAIN_INVALID: The transform is undefined for one or more rows. Correct the data or choose another transform.
TRANSFORM.RESULT_NONFINITE: This transform exceeds the supported numerical range. Rescale the experiment or choose another transform.
MODEL.INSUFFICIENT_POINTS: Add more measurements: the fit needs at least one residual degree of freedom.
MODEL.INSUFFICIENT_DISTINCT_X: The model needs more distinct transformed x values to identify its coefficients.
MODEL.BASIS_NONFINITE: A polynomial term exceeds double-precision range. Choose a lower-degree model or a different transform.
MODEL.DESIGN_MATRIX_RANK_DEFICIENT: The measured x values cannot independently identify all model coefficients.
MODEL.CONDITION_NUMBER_EXTREME: The fit is too sensitive to small changes to report reliable coefficients. Collect more widely spaced measurements.
MODEL.CONDITION_NUMBER_HIGH: Small changes in the data may cause large changes in these coefficients.
MODEL.RESULT_UNREPRESENTABLE: A result falls outside reliable double-precision range. Change the scale of the experiment.
MODEL.FIXED_ZERO_ASSUMPTION: A zero intercept is an assumption you chose. Explain why zero transformed x should imply zero y in this experiment.
MODEL.SHIFT_WITH_FIXED_ZERO: Shifting the origin changes where the model is forced through zero. Check this against the physical setup.
UNIT.COEFFICIENT_DIMENSION_MISMATCH: The claimed coefficient unit has different dimensions from the fitted coefficient. Divide the y unit by the unit of its x term.
METRIC.R_SQUARED_UNDEFINED: R² is undefined because all y values are identical. The coefficients and residuals remain available.
INTERPRETATION.FIT_NOT_PHYSICAL_PROOF: A close fit does not establish a physical law. Check your model assumptions, measurement procedure, and residual pattern.
